test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the following information carefully and answer the question that follows.

The following are the eligibility criteria for becoming a member of a library.

(i) The applicant should be able to pay a one-time membership fee of Rs. 10,000 and contribute two books worth Rs. 500.

(ii) The one-time membership fee is relaxed up to 50% if the applicant donates books worth Rs.5,000 in total.

(iii) For school students, membership fee is relaxed till the age of 18 years.

(iv) Serving school teachers are required to pay only Rs. 2,000 if they help 20 students to become members of the library.

(v) Only for serving Defence personnel and their wards, the membership of the library is free of cost.

Data/information about an individual is given. You have to decide, based on the information provided, under which criterion/criteria is the individual eligible, if so, to get a membership. Please note that an individual can be eligible under more than one criteria. You are not to assume anything other than the information provided in each question.

Mr. A is 30-years-old and the son of a retired army officer. He is ready to pay a membership fee of Rs. 10,000 and contribute two books worth Rs. 500.
solution:
All conditions are as follows:

 
 

 **Eligibility criteria Number**
 **Details**
 **Fulfillment**
 
 

 i
 The applicant should be able to pay a one-time membership fee of Rs. 10,000 and contribute two books worth Rs. 500.
 Yes, as Mr. A is ready to pay a membership fee of Rs. 10,000 and contribute two books worth Rs. 500.
 
 

 ii
 The one-time membership fee is relaxed up to 50% if the applicant donates books worth Rs.5,000 in total.
 No, as Mr. A has not donated books worth Rs. 5,000.
 
 

 iii
 For school students, membership fee is relaxed till the age of 18 years.
 No, as Mr. A is 30 years old.
 
 

 iv
 Serving school teachers are required to pay only Rs. 2,000 if they help 20 students to become members of the library.
 No, as there is no information provided that Mr. A is a serving school teacher or has helped 20 students to become members.
 
 

 v
 Only for serving Defence personnel and their wards, the membership of the library is free of cost.
 No, as Mr. A is the son of a retired army officer, not a serving Defence personnel.
 
 

Therefore, Mr. A fulfills the eligibility criteria (i) to become a member of the library.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Eligible only under (i)**".
